name: Acidsquares
author: E. T. Carter
description: A checkerboard printed on a surface that will not hold still: travelling ripples spread from drifting centres, a slow melt runs the squares downward like softened vinyl, and a long swell leans the whole board. Compressed folds sink into shadow, stretched runs lift, a restrained gloss slides across the ripple crests, and every edge carries a thin chromatic fringe that widens where the warp bites hardest. Light squares glow in a palette hue keyed to the ripple height and pulse on a slow beat over near-black tinted glass.

params.label: Squares
params.effect: Squares down the frame height; low is a few huge tiles, high is a fine dense board.

params.label: Ripple
params.effect: Amplitude of the travelling ripples; 0 is a calm board, high throws the squares into deep rings.

params.label: Melt
params.effect: Depth of the downward melt and the lean of the board; 0 keeps the rows straight.

params.label: Fringing
params.effect: Chromatic split at the square edges; 0 is a clean print, high smears colour along every edge.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: Speed of the ripples, the melt flow and the beat pulse; 0 freezes the board.
